exposure: Neonates with dacryocystoceles that resolved at birth
Neonates with dacryocystoceles that persisted at birth
cohort: 49 singleton fetuses diagnosed with a dacryocystocele larger than 5 mm on prenatal ultrasound
finding: The overall incidence of prenatal dacryocystoceles was 0.43%, and gestational age at delivery was a significant predictor of postnatal persistence.
gest_age: Mean gestational age at first detection was 31.2 weeks
